Adjacent span[data-as=p] elements convert like paragraphs

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<div><span data-as=\"p\">First paragraph.</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second paragraph.</span></div>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
